classification.difficultyReason: Find missing horizontal lengths using equal-side marks and opposite-side totals, including mixed measurement units.

spec.description: Closed stepped shape with seven upper horizontal segments and a straight bottom. The upper segments have triple, single, double, single, double, single and triple equality marks in order.
spec.mathematics: The two triple-marked lengths are each 8 mm, the two double-marked lengths are each 4 mm, and the three single-marked lengths are each 6 mm. Their sum equals the bottom length.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens, equality marks and unknown x are visible.

answer.worked:
The matching marks identify equal lengths.
$$\begin{align*}x&=8+6+4+6+4+6+8\\x&=42\end{align*}$$
The bottom length is $42\text{ mm}$.

spec.description: L-shape with tall left arm; all six source labels retain their original units.
spec.mathematics: The bottom length is the sum of the top and inner horizontal lengths. Convert 28 mm to 2.8 cm before subtracting 1.6 cm. The vertical givens are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: The unknown remains x cm; no supplied answer appears in the question figure.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}28\text{ mm}&=2.8\text{ cm}\\x&=2.8-1.6\\x&=1.2\end{align*}$$
The top length is $1.2\text{ cm}$, equivalent to $12\text{ mm}$.

spec.description: Broad rectangular bottom bar with a central upward rectangular projection. Both outer verticals, both projection verticals, both shoulders, top and bottom are labelled.
spec.mathematics: The total horizontal length is 1900 cm. Subtract the left shoulder of 600 cm and the right shoulder of 7 m, converted to 700 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x cm are visible; the response is separate.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}7\text{ m}&=700\text{ cm}\\x&=1900-600-700\\x&=600\end{align*}$$
The top length is $600\text{ cm}$.
